producer: tools/analysis-rerun.mjs driving papers/qrs-equiv-analysis.html at the paper cohort size

inputs.note: the cohort is generated inside the page from committed code (cohort-gen.js + the FULL-lane waveform harness), so this record reads no capture and no night. `--paper-scale` runs the 240 patients the paper states, never the page default of 60.

publishedIn: papers/rmssd-equivalence.html Table 1, the re-measured 2026-10-27 row set (re-measured again 2026-11-27)

population.note: 220 of 240 patients yield a window with all three rMSSD values; the 20 without one are excluded by the page, and the paper states the same two counts.

claims.note: values EXACTLY as papers/rmssd-equivalence.html Table 1 prints them, so each `CLAIM … FROM …#claims/<key>` compares equal. Full precision sits under `result`. A printed value that the measurement does not reproduce DIGIT FOR DIGIT is absent here and named under `notBound`.

notBound.rule: a marker is written only where the measurement reproduces the printed digits exactly. A printed value that merely ROUNDS to the measurement is left unbound, which is the rule #6000 set when a published 0.93 met a measured 0.9295.

abstractRoundings.note: the abstract and conclusion print +3.30 ms, +8.1 %, r 0.81 and an optical-only dispersion of about 6.4 ms. Each is a rounding of a Table 1 value, so the marker binds the table and the abstract stays prose.

result.framing: Three-way rMSSD equivalence on co-generated beats. One ~9-min apnea-cluster window per patient, scored by the REAL PulseDex (RR text reference), ECGDex (raw int16 ECG @130 Hz, R rendered at true beat times), and PpgDex (optical pulse @176 Hz) on the SAME beats. Pairwise Bland–Altman: ECG−Pulse = sampling + QRS detection; PPG−Pulse = + PAT jitter (+ optical detection); PAT-jitter SD = quadrature excess of PPG−Pulse over ECG−Pulse. SYNTHETIC GROUND TRUTH — certifies detector agreement and quantifies intrinsic dispersion, not a real-patient equivalence study.
result.reproduction: every printed Table 1 bias, bias percentage and limit of agreement reproduces digit for digit, in both electrical and optical arms, 31 days after the 2026-10-27 re-measurement and over 2 further code generations. The three SD columns and the two optical Pearson values reproduce only after rounding, and they stay unbound.
